# apps

The applications page at `/website/apps` — the left fork of the homepage.

It asks one question ("What will apps evolve into?") and owns the
`WebsiteApps.Section` slot the answer will be written into. The page itself
contributes no section: the body is the question and the slot, so writing the
answer means adding a plugin, never editing this one.

The nav link is contributed into the shell's shared `WebsiteHeader`, so the
shell never names this page.
